items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: But they didn't have Chani, they had Henry Zeno, you see.

ctx.x: Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.

See, I never heard their band. They'd tell me they had fine bands, you know. I know most of the musical bands, you know. See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know, Piku, Teal, you know. Always had good musicians they did, you know. See, good reading musicians, you know. You get it? But all the band like Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan, they were a little tongue band. Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know. They had a nice musical band. Nice rhythm section, a little Chani on…
So those were some of the outstanding men on the instruments. Those were some of the outstanding men on the guitar players, banjo players, bass, drums.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He resembled me. See, he was a fellow just on my order. He was playing with Ridgely's Tuxedo Band.

ctx.x: Can you tell anything about some of the other early drummers that you liked? You mentioned Henry Martin, did you remember any other drummers of that time? Henry Zeno. How did he play? Fine.
Who was he with? He resembled me. See, he was a fellow just on my order. He was playing with Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. Oh, he was really good. At that time. He was a drummer.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Henry Zeno, most of us, that's the way we done.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. But, uh, we got tape after tape on dad. Yeah. Because I knew he was about to go and he needed a little comfort, you know. Yeah. And the friendship. He liked to see punch, you know. Uh-huh. All that. You mentioned a while back something about a guitar solo, how you'd come down for that?

Yeah. How the drummer would come down. He'd hit on, he'd play on the rim, crush roll on the rims. That's the way I did most of the drummers, Henry Martin, you know. Henry Zeno, most of us, that's the way we done. Play on the rim, see. Crush roll on the rims. It's something nice. Oh. With that beat off the cymbal, you see, on your bass drum. Just like you play your bass drum now, see.
And you took the cymbal out?
